scripts.db:migrate: echo 'Pick a target network: `npm run db:migrate:preprod` or `npm run db:migrate:mainnet` (never the bare wrangler command, it defaults to mainnet).' && exit 1
scripts.db:migrate:preprod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c workers/gov-sync/wrangler.toml --env preprod --remote
scripts.db:migrate:mainnet: bash scripts/confirm-prod.sh 'D1 migrations apply (mainnet DB "dreptalk")' && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrate:list:preprod: wrangler d1 migrations list DB -c workers/gov-sync/wrangler.toml --env preprod --remote
scripts.deploy:app: CONFIRM_PROD_SOFT=1 bash scripts/confirm-prod.sh 'app worker deploy (mainnet)' && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:sync: CONFIRM_PROD_SOFT=1 bash scripts/confirm-prod.sh 'gov-sync worker deploy (mainnet)' && wrangler deploy -c workers/gov-sync/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:mainnet: CONFIRM_PROD_SOFT=1 bash scripts/confirm-prod.sh 'mainnet deploy (app + gov-sync)' && CONFIRM_PROD_OK=1 npm run deploy:app && CONFIRM_PROD_OK=1 npm run deploy:sync
scripts.deploy:preprod: npm run deploy:app:preprod && npm run deploy:sync:preprod
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:mainnet && npm run deploy:preprod
